title: Assembling locally constant direct images from disjoint components
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $n\geq0$ be an integer, and let $W_i$ for $i\in\operatorname{Fin}(n)$ be pairwise disjoint open subschemes whose union is $X$. Write $j_i:W_i\to X$ for their inclusions. For an abelian etale sheaf $E$ on $X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], suppose the underlying set sheaf of $(f\circ j_i)_*(j_i^*E)$ is locally constant for every $i$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Then the underlying set sheaf of $f_*E$ is locally constant. No finiteness assumption on $f$, no universal-homeomorphism assumption on the component maps, and no finite-stalk assumption on $E$ is made. The family may be empty.

source.place: ## Proof, finite-algebra calculation and final paragraph

proof.text: Base change the disjoint component cover along each etale test object over Y. The sheaf axiom identifies sections with the product of the component sections, since the intersections are empty and an abelian sheaf has a unique section on the empty object. Naturality of restriction makes these identifications an isomorphism of set sheaves from the direct image to the product of the component direct images.

Choose a trivializing etale cover for each component direct image and form their finite fibre-product refinement. Each factor is constant on every member. Constant set sheaves commute with finite products: the constant presheaf functor preserves products and etale sheafification is left exact. Thus the finite product is constant on each member. Transport through the preceding isomorphism. For an empty family X is empty by the cover assumption, and the direct image is the constant singleton set sheaf.

lean.statement:
theorem isLocallyConstant_disjoint_components_directImage
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (n : ℕ) (W : Fin n → X.Opens)
    (hcover : (⨆ i, W i) = ⊤)
    (hdisjoint : Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (W i) (W j)))
    (E : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hcomponents : ∀ i, IsLocallyConstantEtaleSheafOfSets
      ((sheafCompose Y.smallEtaleTopology
        (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
          ((Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ((W i).ι ≫ f)).obj
            ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (W i).ι).obj E)))) :
    IsLocallyConstantEtaleSheafOfSets
      ((sheafCompose Y.smallEtaleTopology
        (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
          ((Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).obj E))
